headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-snug

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use 2x-3x standard padding (py-16 to py-32 for homepage sections, p-6 to p-10 for containers)
layout_and_spacing.editorial_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8 lg:gap-12
layout_and_spacing.bento_ratios: Mix 3:4 portrait product cards with 16:9 full-bleed campaign banners

clothing_rack_spec.type: Layered photo rack with CSS 3D depth & Framer Motion

environment.floor_shadow: Diffuse ambient blur shadow below rack base
environment.decorations: Minimalist brass side lamp glow and botanical shadow silhouette

structure.rack_frame: Matte black metal double-bar architecture (#1A1817) with subtle 1px brass hardware accents
structure.hangers: Dark oak realistic wooden hanger silhouettes with metallic brass hooks (#C5A880)

garments.aspect_ratio: 3:4 portrait webp model cutouts hanging seamlessly below wooden hangers

desktop_behavior.hover: Garment scales up (1.12x), translates forward (translateZ 40px, translateY -8px), shadow-2xl elevation, z-index elevates to z-30
desktop_behavior.neighbors: Immediate left and right adjacent garments push outward horizontally (translateX +/- 24px) creating clear breathing space
desktop_behavior.leave: Smooth spring return to default aligned rack position
desktop_behavior.click: Triggers quick product modal preview or navigates directly to PDP

mobile_behavior.top_display: Rack container with horizontal touch-scroll or snap alignment
mobile_behavior.bottom_selectors: Numbered pill bar (01 to 10) below rack
mobile_behavior.selection: Tapping a number highlights the garment with brass border ring, scales it up, and centers it in view; tapping garment opens product page

header.style: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 border-b border-[#E6DFD5]
header.logo: DRESSELLA wordmark in Cormorant Garamond font-light tracking-[0.3em] uppercase text-2xl sm:text-3xl

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A1918] text-[#FDFBF7] hover:bg-[#A38F78] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-medium
buttons.secondary: border border-[#1A1918] text-[#1A1918] bg-transparent hover:bg-[#1A1918] hover:text-[#FDFBF7] transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-medium
buttons.frosted_pill: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 border border-[#1A1918]/30 text-[#1A1918] hover:bg-[#1A1918] hover:text-[#FDFBF7] rounded-full px-6 py-3 text-xs tracking-[0.15em] uppercase transition-all duration-300

cards.product_card: Flat solid ivory container, 3:4 aspect ratio image container, dual image hover swap, quiet typography with title in Cormorant Garamond and price in Manrope font-medium

overlays.bag_drawer: Slide-over panel from right, bg-[#FDFBF7] with header, free shipping progress bar, items list with quantity controls, subtotal & checkout CTA
overlays.search_overlay: Full-screen luxury search overlay with quick recommendations, recent searches, and instant live product search results

general_ui_ux_guidelines.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 ratio). Explicit hover state colors set.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.test_id_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, selectors MUST have descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.file_structure: React CRA with JS/JSX files in /frontend/src and FastAPI routes in /backend.
